title: p6-satellite-extension
purpose: PK-6 Step 1 probe (PACK-ROADMAP.md card PK-6, satellite concepts): the built-in identity pack composed with a throwaway extension pack ('clinical') that declares a satellite concept (satelliteOf: "identity::User") adding clinical fields to identity::User without modifying identity itself.
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo -- serves the PK-6 Step 1 live proof and nothing else.
identity is a TRANSITIVE dependency (declared only by packs/clinical/pack.json's own packs[]), never $ref'd directly by model.json -- also exercises PK-3's transitive resolution.
Built for scripts/proofs/run-pk6-satellite-extension-proof.py; not intended to be run by hand.
expectedOutcomes: identity::User's physical table (identity_v1_users) is byte-identically shaped whether or not the clinical extension is composed.
clinical::UserClinicalProfile gets its own physical table (clinical_v1_user_clinical_profiles) with a unique FK to identity_v1_users.id, ON DELETE CASCADE.
A row inserted through identity::User's generated CRUD endpoint can be referenced by a row inserted through the satellite's own generated CRUD endpoint.
